description:
Follow-up of defk-9p6.31, which built the generator (2026-10-15). The tables in examples/README.md (scoreboard) and README.md (summary) are still the hand-written 2026-10-13 copies; the first stored run makes them generated.

Steps, on a quiet machine (no builds, no other agents; ~28 min):
1. mix defk.examples --bench --all --snapshot --fresh  (writes examples/scoreboard.json only when every example behaves as claimed; check its "quiet": true).
2. Wrap the two tables in markers: examples/README.md's scoreboard table and its 'Measured on ...' paragraph go between <!-- scoreboard:start --> and <!-- scoreboard:end -->; README.md's intro sentence and summary table between <!-- summary:start --> and <!-- summary:end -->.
3. mix defk.examples.tables, review the diff (verdict changes, new numbers), fix examples/_tables.exs text if a placeholder fails.
4. Drop the 'From the next quiet run on (the table below is still the 2026-10-13 copy)' clause in examples/README.md.
5. mix ci (test/scoreboard_doc_test.exs then checks the tables against the JSON).

Done when: scoreboard.json is committed from a quiet run, both tables are generated, and mix ci is green.

comments.text: Done by defk-9p7 (PR #44, commit 307a96ef): scoreboard.json stored from a quiet run at 8fa900b7, markers in both READMEs, tables generated; defk-q58 (PR #45) re-measured the four provisional rows. test/scoreboard_doc_test.exs passes on main 25954894.

title: Seed examples/scoreboard.json on a quiet machine and switch the README tables to the generator
